title: Psephellus sibiricus subsp. leaves extraction protocol
author: Nawrot, Joanna
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Crush leaves and soak in MeOH
steps.instruction: Weigh 453 g of dried P. sibiricus subsp. leaves, crush them thoroughly, and soak the powder in methanol (MeOH) sufficient to fully immerse the material.

steps.title: Evaporate MeOH and dissolve residue
steps.instruction: Evaporate the methanol extract to dryness, then dissolve the resulting residue in water (H₂O).

steps.title: Re‑extract aqueous solution with CH₂Cl₂
steps.instruction: Extract the aqueous solution with dichloromethane (CH₂Cl₂) to transfer organic compounds into the organic phase.

steps.title: Dry, filter and evaporate CH₂Cl₂ extract
steps.instruction: Dry the CH₂Cl₂ extract over anhydrous Na₂SO₄, filter off the drying agent, and evaporate the filtrate to afford a residue weighing 10.9 g.

steps.title: Column chromatography on silica gel
steps.instruction: Load the 10.9 g residue onto a silica‑gel column and elute with mixtures of CH₂Cl₂ and acetone ((CH₃)₂CO) using a step gradient of ratios 45:1, then 35:1, then 10:1 (CH₂Cl₂ : acetone).

steps.title: Collect fractions and isolate compounds
steps.instruction: Collect the eluted fractions, combine those containing each target compound, and evaporate solvent to obtain: scoparone (12.7 mg, amorphous solid), scopoletin (45.4 mg, m.p. 192–195 °C), umbelliferone (63.7 mg, m.p. 230 °C), cynaropicrin (6.7 mg, amorphous solid), and desacylcynaropicrin (3.9 mg, amorphous solid). Record NMR data as listed in Tables 7 and 8.
